summary: Pick this when the room wants an emotionally heavy, music-soaked teen drama that feels more like memory than plot. Reviewers respond to its beautiful distance and pain: one calls it the "Finest 146 minute pop song about being a teenager ever composed."
good_pick_if: You want a gorgeous but bruising mood piece about adolescence, isolation, and pop obsession.
maybe_skip_if: The group needs something light, comforting, or easy to shake off afterward.

source_quotes.text: Finest 146 minute pop song about being a teenager ever composed.
The movie's more of a collection of memories.

summary: This is the classic pick for raw moral pressure, dockside grit, and Brando at full wounded-animal intensity. Even viewers wrestling with its politics still land on the force of it: "Very powerful" is the plainest, truest signal.
good_pick_if: You want a heavyweight 1950s drama built around conscience, atmosphere, and a magnetic lead performance.
maybe_skip_if: You are not in the mood for talky moral conflict or Kazan-era historical baggage.

source_quotes.text: Brando's performance really did live up to my expectations.
eva marie saint absolutely kills it in her first film role

summary: Good for a group ready for a tense, bruising melodrama where one accusation turns the room cold fast. The performances are the hook: a quoted line "contained so much power" that viewers still feel it decades later.
good_pick_if: You want an old-Hollywood drama with sharp moral stakes and emotionally loaded performances.
maybe_skip_if: The group wants queer joy, comfort, or a drama without period-era cruelty.

source_quotes.text: contained so much power it catapulted through time 58 years into the future
martha deserved the world and the stars and the sun

summary: Choose this for a patient, nocturnal mystery where the search matters less than the silences, faces, and stray flashes of beauty. It is demanding by design: one reviewer calls it "long, tiresome and difficult" and still a masterpiece.
good_pick_if: You want a quiet, hypnotic crime drama that rewards attention to pauses and small gestures.
maybe_skip_if: Anyone in the room is restless or wants a fast case-solving thriller.

source_quotes.text: the transitory, often unseen moments of intense beauty

summary: This is a quiet, spellbound pick for viewers who like childhood memory, political shadow, and cinema as a kind of ghost story. Fans point to its softness and unease, calling it a "gorgeous, meditative film" that asks you to lean in.
good_pick_if: You want a slow, beautiful art film about imagination, fear, and seeing the world as a child.
maybe_skip_if: The group needs plot momentum, clear explanations, or a louder supernatural movie.

source_quotes.text: one of the most beautiful films I've ever seen
